source_read: Firmdale Hotels' own restaurant pages (Ham Yard, Brumus at the Haymarket Hotel, Refuel at The Soho Hotel, Brasserie Max at the Covent Garden Hotel, Oscar at the Charlotte Street Hotel, The Potting Shed at the Dorset Square Hotel; listed in https://www.firmdalehotels.com/sitemap.xml) and the 31 breakfast, brunch, a la carte, bar food and dessert menu pages they link under /menus/, fetched 2026-10-12 (robots.txt has no rules). Warren Street, Crosby Street and The Whitby are in New York and were not read.
not_verifiable: whether every restaurant still serves each dish on a given day (menus change; the pages carry no date); allergens are not published online ('Please speak to the team')
notes: Second read by another method: each menu page re-parsed with Python's html.parser into plain text lines (not the extractor's regular expressions), and for every published item the lines naming it were listed for all six restaurants and compared by eye with items.csv: the figure printed beside the name matches at every restaurant claimed (e.g. 'Toast, preserves £6 (V 392kcal)' at all six; 'Eggs Royale / single £11 / double £22 (440 / 879kcal)' and 'single £11 (439kcal) / double £22 (879kcal)' give the double 879 everywhere while the single portion differs, so only the double is published), and no other figure is printed for the same name; the two one-dish sections (English Breakfast 722 kcal at Brumus, Brasserie Max, Oscar and The Potting Shed; Porridge 354 / 227 / 1133 kcal with milk, water or cream at all six) were read from the headings and the line below them. 0 differences. Held back after the second read because the chain's menus print the same dish under a slightly different name with another figure: Danish pastry (Oscar 'Croissant / Danish (239 / 144)', Refuel 'Danish pastry (239 / 144)'), Eggs Benedict (brunch 859 kcal vs 884 kcal for a double at Ham Yard and Brumus), Classic Caesar salad (760 vs Brasserie Max's Caesar salad 758). 25 names that print different figures at different restaurants (e.g. Free range bacon 190 / 232, Baked beans 87 / 120, Caesar salad 758 / 760) are left out, never chosen between.
